column1: # One row per tool that must run after its package is installed. A row is used
# only if the package is installed, so a package that is not built for a series
# needs no entry. @TOOLS@ is the kernel's tools directory
# (/usr/lib/linux-<vendor>-tools-<abi>) and @TOOLSPKG@ is the package that owns
# it. The command runs under bash, as root,
